Cloud computing?
The on-demand delivery of computing resources such as servers, storage and software over the internet, usually paid for as used.
Infrastructure as a service (I-A-A-S)?
A cloud model in which the provider supplies virtualised hardware such as servers, storage and networking, and the customer manages the operating system and software.
Platform as a service (pass)?
A cloud model in which the provider supplies the hardware, operating system and development platform so customers only build and manage their own applications.
Software as a service (sass)?
A cloud model in which complete application software is hosted by the provider and accessed by users over the internet.
Hybrid cloud?
A cloud deployment that combines a private cloud with public cloud services, allowing data and applications to move between them.
Virtualisation?
The use of software to create virtual versions of hardware, allowing several virtual machines to run on one physical computer.
